$comment: Registered editorial homes. Each entry says where a collection's prose lives and how to find a case inside it, so scripts/check-dossier-sync.mjs can compare dossier against built record for any collection rather than only for Featured v1. A frozen or released record whose collection has no entry here fails the check: at freeze, 'the dossier and the record agree' has to be a measured fact, and an unregistered collection used to mean the comparison was silently skipped. Draft and editorial-review work needs no entry.

sources.note: Twenty families across five dossier files, each family a '## Fxx — Title' section; the section id maps to the record whose case_id starts with that id, lowercased.
